content.value: The grade on a quiz were $0 , 1 , 2 , \ldots , 1 0$ points, depending on the number answered correctly (10) [CO out of 30 questions. The mean grade was 6.50 and the standard deviation was 1.1. Express with appropriate assumptions to determine following probabilities, and then determine:
i) The percentage of student scoring 7.0 point.
ii) The maximum grade of the lowest 10% of the class.
iii) The minimum grade of the highest 10% of the class.
